source.note: DPMotion implementation is evaluated from its own InterGen-derived code; official InterGen checkout is only the reference for checkpoint/normalization provenance.

model.normalization: code/DPMotion/data/global_mean.npy and global_std.npy link to official InterGen; arrays byte/numeric identical

rag.source: all InterHuman annotations (no split filtering, as upstream code)
rag.clip: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14@336px from existing assets/clip cache

sampling.algorithm: repository InterDiffusion.forward_single -> p_sample_loop_multi -> DDPM ancestral sampling
sampling.config_strategy_note: STRATEGY=ddim50 in model.yaml is not used by this forward_single; it explicitly respaces to all 1000 steps
sampling.smoothing: scipy gaussian_filter1d(sigma=1, axis=time, mode=nearest), upstream eval path
sampling.scene_seed: base_seed + integer file_id, applied to Python, NumPy and Torch/CUDA before every scene; reproducibility plumbing because upstream seed controls only list subsampling

evaluation.cross_scene_diversity: not implemented by current eval code; README number cannot be recomputed from a published definition in this repository
